name: Quest Flow Controls Ltd
summary: Quest Flow Controls Limited assembles, buys, sells, distributes, imports, exports, or deals in valves, actuators, strainers, and remote-control valves systems to various industries in India and internationally. The company engages in manufacturing of special purpose machinery. It also deals in products, such as control cabinets, tanks, visualization systems, piping products, pumps, fittings, gaskets, flanges, and measurement devices. In addition, the company engages in the installation, maintaining, servicing, or handling of equipment and services that control and manage its products. Further, it offers butterfly, gate, and globe valve; quick closing tools, IPMS-compatible valves, and type-tested alloy steel valves. Additionally, the company provides flow control technology services comprising end-to-end capabilities, design engineering, component sourcing, in-house machining and hydro-testing, assembly, distribution, installation, and aftersales service. It supplies its products primarily to naval, oil and gas, power, refineries, and general industries. The company was formerly known as Meson Valves India Limited and changed its name to Quest Flow Controls Limited in June 2025. Quest Flow Controls Limited was founded in 2003 and is based in Verna, India.
